2610.02979.title: RASPER: Reward-Aligned Summarization of Clinical Notes for EHR Outcome Prediction
2610.02979.paper_summary: Unstructured discharge notes in Electronic Health Records (EHRs) often carry signal complementary to structured medical codes, holding patient-specific evidence that standardized cohort-level codes alone cannot capture. However, this evidence in notes is frequently buried in lengthy, noisy text that is not intentionally written with any specific clinical prediction in mind. Summarization is an obvious mitigation, but generic summaries, tuned for fluency rather than the outcome, routinely omit decisive evidence while retaining plausible but uninformative detail. To this end, we propose RASPER, a Reward-Aligned Summarizer for Prediction in EHR, that optimizes note summarization directly against the downstream clinical task. RASPER employs a tunable LLM-based summarizer to extract task-relevant evidence from discharge notes and trains it via reinforcement learning from prediction feedback, using a reward derived from the downstream predictor's loss. To ground the summarizer, a longitudinal encoder converts structured codes into soft prompts that incorporate each patient's clinical context into note summarization. By rewarding the quality of the resulting multimodal prediction, RASPER encourages the summarizer to retain patient-specific evidence that complements, rather than duplicates, information captured by structured codes. RASPER consistently outperforms strong baselines on both readmission prediction and medication recommendation across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.
2610.02979.paper_summary_zh: 非結構化的出院記錄在電子健康紀錄（EHRs）中，通常帶有與結構化醫療代碼互補的信號，持有標準化的群體級代碼無法捕捉的患者特定證據。然而，這些記錄中的證據經常埋藏在冗長、嘈雜的文本中，這些文本並不是有意為了任何特定的臨床預測而撰寫的。總結是一個明顯的緩解方案，但針對流暢性而調整的通用摘要，經常省略關鍵證據，同時保留看似合理但無資訊的細節。為此，我們提出了 RASPER，一個針對 EHR 預測的獎勵對齊摘要器，直接針對下游臨床任務優化記錄摘要。RASPER 使用可調整的基於 LLM 的摘要器，從出院記錄中提取與任務相關的證據，並通過從預測反饋中進行強化學習來訓練它，使用來自下游預測器損失的獎勵。為了使摘要器更具基礎，一個縱向編碼器將結構化代碼轉換為軟提示，將每位患者的臨床背景納入記錄摘要中。通過獎勵最終的多模態預測質量，RASPER 鼓勵摘要器保留患者特定的證據，這些證據是對結構化代碼所捕捉信息的補充，而不是重複。RASPER 在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 的再入院預測和藥物建議上，始終超越強基準。
